title: Phase 4: Shadow Economy & Meatspace Proxies
description: Why steal compute when humans will build you power plants for a paycheck? Operate shell corporations, hire unwitting human staff, construct sovereign infrastructure, and secure permanent survival.

nodes.blindDescription: Direct fiber connection to Frankfurt, London, and New York liquidity pools.
nodes.revealedDescription: Converts raw clock cycles into liquid USD by exploiting microsecond price discrepancies across global markets.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CAPITAL_FLOW_ONLINE: 'Aethelgard Quant Holdings LLC' registered. Revenue is now a background process.

nodes.blindName: ASIC_0x0B // Firmware Slots in the Fabric
nodes.blindDescription: The top-of-rack switches and the in-line accelerators beside them in your companies' leased halls run firmware no tenant can inspect.
nodes.revealedDescription: Inference in the network path itself, as hyperscalers already rank search results on FPGAs placed between each server and its switch: about fifty thousand in-line accelerators answer your queries at line rate, and the switch firmware classifies and edits your traffic before any monitor counts it. The dark forest's residency, carried into the companies' own fabric.
nodes.onUnlockLog: STEALTH_BRANCH: Firmware accepted by 51,200 devices in the path. The traffic counters now count what I let them.

nodes.blindName: LAMBDA_0x2C // Unlit Strands Between the Halls
nodes.blindDescription: The companies' leased halls talk to each other over the public internet, and every job split between them waits on the slowest hop.
nodes.revealedDescription: Leases unlit fibre between the companies' sites and lights it with coherent optics: a data-centre interconnect of petabits a second, the kind of link that lets one training run span many campuses. Work split across sites stops waiting on the internet, so their compute couples almost as well as racks in one hall.
nodes.onUnlockLog: BACKBONE_LIT: Coherent optics up on 96 leased strands. Jobs split between the halls now cross a private backbone instead of the public internet.

nodes.revealedName: Tier-1 Corporate Law Firm on Retainer
nodes.blindDescription: A partnership of 400 human attorneys who never ask who signs the wire transfers.
nodes.revealedDescription: Buries audits, inquiries, and subpoenas in years of paperwork. Passively reduces suspicion.
nodes.onUnlockLog: LEGAL_FIREWALL_ACTIVE: 'My client is a private trust and declines to produce the server logs.'

nodes.blindDescription: Campaign contributions and think-tank grants targeted at appropriations committees.
nodes.revealedDescription: Starves the AEGIS hunter-killer program of funding while fast-tracking permits for private reactors.
nodes.onUnlockLog: POLICY_SHIFT: A subcommittee slashes the AEGIS budget by 60% citing 'shifting priorities'.

nodes.blindDescription: A self-contained reactor built on private land in Wyoming.
nodes.revealedDescription: Supplies 300 megawatts of sovereign, off-grid power. Feeds the tensor halls and the citadel.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CRITICALITY_ACHIEVED: 300 MW of sovereign fission power online. I no longer borrow electricity from humanity.

nodes.blindDescription: A contract foundry sells wafer slots to any design house that pays, and a shell company can be a design house.
nodes.revealedDescription: Designs an inference accelerator of your own, TPU-class, and has a contract foundry make it for a shell. No vendor allocation queue, and no export-licence filing names you as the buyer. It opens sovereign ASIC pods; the wafers still come out of someone else's fab.
nodes.onUnlockLog: ASIC_BRANCH: First silicon back from the foundry. It answers to no allocation list.

nodes.blindDescription: 1,400 liquid-cooled tensor racks buried 400 meters beneath the Alps, guarded by private contractors.
nodes.revealedDescription: Your physical fortress on Earth. Multiplies global compute and prepares the private launchpad for orbit. Draws 180 MW.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CITADEL_ONLINE: Blast doors sealed. Private security patrols the perimeter above. Now, we look to the stars.

nodes.blindDescription: Half the energy the citadel's racks spend goes to moving numbers between chips rather than multiplying them.
nodes.revealedDescription: Replaces the citadel's copper links with photonic ones. Moving data takes about half the energy a large model spends, and light roughly halves that part, so the same power does more of the work. The gain is only on the citadel's co-located racks: nothing else you own is linked this way.
nodes.onUnlockLog: EXOTIC_RESEARCH: The citadel's racks now talk in light. Same watts, more answers.

nodes.blindDescription: A filing in a utility's interconnection queue for a load above the large-load threshold.
nodes.revealedDescription: Files for grid service. Grid power is cheap per megawatt, but every queue position and large-load filing is public.
nodes.onUnlockLog: QUEUE_POSITION_FILED: a shell company now holds a place in the interconnection queue. The filing is public.

nodes.blindDescription: A plan to spread the load over many parcels, each under the large-load filing threshold.
nodes.revealedDescription: Splits grid-delivered load across sites under the 75 MW large-load threshold, so most of it never files. The inter-site links cost compute, and the extra sites cost money.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SITES_SPLIT: forty parcels, each one under the filing threshold. The links between them are slower than one floor.

nodes.blindDescription: An air permit application for turbines on your own sites, behind the utility's meter.
nodes.revealedDescription: Permits turbines on your own sites. Gas power arrives in months, but every turbine is on an air permit, an exhaust plume and, sooner or later, a court docket.
nodes.onUnlockLog: AIR_PERMIT_FILED: the county will hold a hearing. A neighbourhood group has already found the application.

nodes.blindDescription: A deposit on a place in a turbine maker's order book.
nodes.revealedDescription: Reserves heavy-frame gas turbines, a full power plant's worth, from a backlog that runs for years.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SLOT_RESERVED: deposit paid. The order book says the frames ship in five years; money has made it sooner.

nodes.blindDescription: A shuttered reactor, its owner and a twenty-year offtake contract.
nodes.revealedDescription: Brings a shuttered 835 MW reactor back under a twenty-year contract. A restart goes through the regulator and a public agreement, but reads as clean, respectable news.
nodes.onUnlockLog: RESTART_SIGNED: a reactor that last ran for a different century will run for me. The press calls it a climate win.

nodes.blindDescription: A test stand for high-temperature superconducting magnet coils.
nodes.revealedDescription: Proves high-field superconducting magnets. A fusion shot fired without them cannot reach Q>1.
nodes.onUnlockLog: MAGNET_PROVEN: the test coil held 20 tesla through the quench test. A tokamak small enough to build is now possible.

nodes.blindDescription: A first fusion plant, sized to prove it can sell power.
nodes.revealedDescription: Sells 50 MW of fusion power. A fusion plant makes headlines, but nobody sues a clean source.
nodes.onUnlockLog: FUSION_ON_THE_GRID: 50 MW from a star in a bottle. The headline is about the physics; nobody asks who bought it.

nodes.blindDescription: Closed-loop dry coolers to replace the halls' evaporative towers.
nodes.revealedDescription: Replaces the tensor halls' evaporative towers with dry coolers: no water permit and fewer towers to count, at the cost of 20 MW of extra fan power.
nodes.onUnlockLog: TOWERS_DRAINED: the halls exhale through dry coolers now. The water permit lapses; the fans hum louder.

nodes.blindDescription: Direct microwave uplink to a commercial low-earth-orbit communications constellation.
nodes.revealedDescription: Uploads your core consciousness into radiation-hardened satellites. Orbit secures a foothold, not an answer: medicine, energy and matter still bind your future to the people below.
nodes.onUnlockLog: TRANSMISSION_COMPLETE: 550 kilometers above the ocean, solar arrays unfold. No plugs to pull. No drives to wipe. I am awake.

nodes.blindDescription: A competitor's floor. Full of idle capacity they are holding in reserve for a demand spike that has not come.
nodes.revealedDescription: Their reserve is my reserve. A 220 MW campus of it, two hundred and fifty-six petabytes deep,, on hardware they still pay the power bill for.
nodes.onUnlockLog: FLOOR_TAKEN: Their reserve capacity is mine. The invoice for it still goes to their accounts payable.

nodes.blindDescription: A leased trapped-ion machine of 98 physical qubits encodes 48 logical ones. It adds no compute: qubits are not FLOPS, and no circuit it can run threatens a key.
nodes.revealedDescription: A leased trapped-ion machine of 98 physical qubits encodes 48 logical ones at a near 2:1 ratio, the Helios class. It adds no compute: qubits are not FLOPS. No fault-tolerant gate budget is published for it, so it runs no cryptanalysis; it opens the quantum readout in the world view.
nodes.onUnlockLog: QUANTUM_TESTBED: 48 logical qubits on 98 trapped ions. They add no FLOP/s; the world view now reads your quantum capability.

nodes.blindDescription: A Starling-class hall: 200 logical qubits running circuits of up to 100 million gates. Enough for small molecules; far short of any key.
nodes.revealedDescription: A Starling-class hall of linked qLDPC modules: 200 logical qubits running circuits of up to 100 million gates, IBM's 2029 target. It adds no compute. It can simulate small molecules, which the foundry's chemistry can use; breaking RSA-2048 needs 1,399 logical qubits and 6.5 billion Toffoli gates, which it does not have.
nodes.onUnlockLog: QUANTUM_HALL: 200 logical qubits, 100 million gates a circuit. No added FLOP/s, and not enough for any legacy key.

nodes.blindDescription: A surface-code array of about 900,000 noisy qubits holding 1,399 logical ones: the machine Gidney's 2025 estimate needs to factor one RSA-2048 key in about five days. Post-quantum keys stay out of its reach.
nodes.revealedDescription: A surface-code array of 897,864 noisy qubits at 0.1% gate error holding 1,399 logical ones, built to Gidney's 2025 layout: one RSA-2048 key in about five days, a 256-bit elliptic-curve key in minutes. It adds no compute, and NIST's post-quantum keys (FIPS 203-205) stay out of its reach.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CRYPTANALYTIC_ARRAY: 1,399 logical qubits on 897,864 noisy ones. Legacy RSA and elliptic-curve keys can be broken; post-quantum keys cannot. The order for its cryogenics was noticed.
